summary: Backend-only regression + new feature testing for Cropido super-app. All 30 pytest cases PASSED (100%) against public preview URL. Verified: (1) Real Stripe test-mode checkout — both /api/payments/checkout/subscription and /api/payments/checkout/order return real https://checkout.stripe.com/... URLs with valid session_id; DB-persisted payment_transactions record has payment_status='pending' and correct kind/plan_id. /api/payments/status/{session_id} correctly polls Stripe and returns 'unpaid'/'pending' without _id leakage; 404 for unknown session. Auth enforced (401 without token). (2) Live Weather /api/weather?lat=19.076&lon=72.877 returns real Open-Meteo data with temp/condition/humidity/wind/icon and forecast[] array of {day,temp,icon}. (3) Admin RBAC — non-admin demo user gets 403 on /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/users; unauth gets 401. Admin login (admin@cropido.app / admin1234) succeeds with role='admin'. /api/admin/stats returns totals (users, verified, farmers, products, crop_listings, orders, community_posts, revenue, paid_transactions), plan_counts (all 4 plans), recent_orders — all free of MongoDB _id. /api/admin/users returns users without password_hash or _id. /api/admin/users/{id}/verify sets verified=true+kyc_verified=true (persistence verified via GET). /api/admin/products/{id} DELETE removes product (verified via GET → 404). (4) Regression: dashboard, products, crops, equipment, services, community/posts, knowledge, businesses, notifications, subscriptions/plans, payments list, ai/chat (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1430 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, marketplace, payments, admin, weather, ai) for maintainability. Above the 700-line guideline.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty in backend/.env — /api/webhook/stripe is registered but signature verification will rely on emergentintegrations default; ensure Stripe dashboard webhook secret is configured for production.

checkout_order does NOT validate that the order_id exists in db.orders — a malicious authenticated user could create a Stripe session for arbitrary order_ids. Consider fetching db.orders and asserting ownership + amount match before creating session.

admin_stats: uses `payments` collection for revenue, but Stripe-confirmed payments only get inserted here when payment_status transitions to 'paid'. Revenue will be $0 in test mode until an actual test payment completes. This is expected but worth documenting for admin dashboard.

checkout_subscription: subscribes user only on payment_status=='paid' via /status polling or webhook — this is correct; the legacy /api/subscriptions/subscribe endpoint still mock-upgrades without payment (should either be removed or gated to admin/testing only in prod).
get_current_user cleanly handles both JWT and Emergent session_token — good.
